llm.summary: This is mostly a coherent Walmart data-collection wrapper, but it needs review because it can use a saved Dataify token for third-party tasks and one localized instruction may ask users to provide the token in chat.

dimensions.detail: Reading DATAIFY_API_TOKEN and posting Walmart collection parameters to scraperapi.dataify.com are proportionate to the skill purpose, but users should understand that saved credentials and account credits may be used.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No hidden installer or auto-start mechanism was found. Metadata is empty and the script depends on a sibling dataify-task-operations runtime, which is a reliability and disclosure issue rather than malicious installation behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The English instructions scope use to Walmart collection and say not to paste tokens, but the Chinese instructions also tell the agent to ask for or use a user-provided API token before later saying never to ask for the token in chat; openai.yaml also enables implicit invocation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill suggests persistent environment-variable setup only with user confirmation and the script only reads the token; no privilege escalation, background worker, or automatic persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the implementation: submit Walmart URL, category, SKU, or keyword collection jobs to Dataify Builder and optionally monitor results.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only if you intend to send Walmart product targets to Dataify and are comfortable with your Dataify account token and credits being used. Configure DATAIFY_API_TOKEN locally outside chat, do not paste the token into a conversation, and explicitly confirm the collection scope for multi-page or high-volume jobs.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Accepted as a disclosure concern but downgraded as a verdict driver: the environment token and Dataify network request are expected for this API wrapper and are visible in SKILL.md and the script, though permissions are not declared in metadata.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Partially accepted: implicit invocation is enabled, and although the skill descriptions narrow use to Walmart collection and require confirmation for higher-cost scopes, automatic use with a saved token could still submit third-party tasks without an explicit skill invocation.
[SSD-3] unexpected: Accepted: SKILL.zh-CN.md contains contradictory token guidance that could lead a user to paste an API token into chat, which is unnecessary because the script uses DATAIFY_API_TOKEN from the local environment.
